2. Back up before moving or clearing dat: 2. Back up before moving or clearing data
Choose Download JSON backup to save the: Choose Download JSON backup to save the current collection. Keep the downloaded file somewhere you can find independently of this browser. Local saving is tied to this browser profile and site origin; another device, a private window or a future domain change will not automatically bring the collection across.
There is no account-based recovery. Befo: There is no account-based recovery. Before clearing site data, changing browsers or moving to another domain, export your collection. A shared link contains one build and is not a backup of the entire list.
On the destination browser, open Import: On the destination browser, open Import JSON and select a planner backup. The app validates the file, then asks whether to replace your saved list. Export any destination builds you want to keep before accepting. Import is replacement, not a merge.
The V1 importer accepts version 1 planne: The V1 importer accepts version 1 planner backups with unique IDs, up to 100 builds and a 1 MB input limit. A tracker backup is a different format. If validation fails, select the original planner export rather than manually guessing missing fields. If saving fails, the app reports the error and retains its current list.

Choose Share on a saved card and copy th: Choose Share on a saved card and copy the displayed link. It includes the build fields, including Strategy notes, in the URL fragment. Anyone who receives the full link can read those notes. Review the card before sharing and keep personal information out of it.
Opening a valid link shows a Shared prev: Opening a valid link shows a Shared preview. It does not overwrite saved builds. The recipient must choose Save a copy on this device to add it to their own collection. Later changes to either copy do not update the other: a share link is a snapshot, not a synchronized document.

First ask who published the information: First ask who published the information
Official identifies developer or platfor: Official identifies developer or platform publications. Community covers independent press and player reports. These labels describe the source category, not a numerical confidence score. A detailed press observation can be useful while still being labeled Community.
Project documentation is a separate labe: Project documentation is a separate label on these guides. It supports statements about how this website saves, imports or displays your notes. It is not an official game source and should not be cited as proof of an in-game mechanic.
Then ask which stage the evidence descri: Then ask which stage the evidence describes
Pre-release means the information comes: Pre-release means the information comes from announcements or demonstrations before release. Verified is reserved for facts checked against the released game. The two dimensions answer different questions: an Official source may still describe a Pre-release feature.
A calendar reaching the scheduled launch: A calendar reaching the scheduled launch does not verify a reference entry. Neither a tracker checkbox nor your private planner note changes our editorial labels. Post-release checking must establish the relevant fact before an entry can be marked Verified.
Read the source date and the editorial d: Read the source date and the editorial date separately
The source may have been published well: The source may have been published well before our review. Last updated identifies the editorial date attached to this page or record; a source’s Checked date indicates when it was reviewed for the guide. Neither date means the developer released a new announcement that day.
For example, a demo article published in: For example, a demo article published in 2025 can be reviewed in September 2026 and still describe that earlier demo. Follow the linked source, check its original context, and avoid reading the newer review date as evidence of a newer game version.
Read the claim, its source category and: Read the claim, its source category and its stage together. Open the source and locate the passage supporting the claim. Then read the limitation: does the page describe a system, a single reported encounter or your own tool usage?
When sources disagree, retain their date: When sources disagree, retain their dates and contexts in your own research notes instead of combining them into one definitive statement. On this site, missing final stats and incomplete lists are intentional boundaries until evidence supports expanding them.
